# files.ethz.ch

> > ETH Zurich file hosting and sharing service for the university community.

This service provides secure file storage, sharing, and collaboration capabilities for ETH Zurich students, faculty, and staff. The platform supports academic workflows and research data management needs.

## Key Topics

- File hosting
- ETH Zurich services
- Document sharing
- Collaboration tools
- Academic storage
- Research data management
- Secure file transfer
- University infrastructure
- Cloud storage
- Access management
